hypothesis: Opening-auction absorption can act immediately, while apparent initiative requires one completed causal auction-acceptance bar before follow or fade. Separating those clocks can retain frequent genuine rejection trades without paying immediately for unresolved drive noise.

profiles_in_frozen_selection_order.initiative_verdict: first completed five-minute CL/MCL bar after the opening auction
second completed five-minute CL/MCL bar after the opening auction
profiles_in_frozen_selection_order.role: count-eligibility neighbor only if the one-bar primary is ineligible

branch_clock.absorption: retain the exact V35 immediate next-open direction and timestamp
branch_clock.initiative_acceptance_up: both CL and MCL verdict closes exceed their own opening-auction closes; retain up
branch_clock.initiative_acceptance_down: both CL and MCL verdict closes are below their own opening-auction closes; retain down
branch_clock.initiative_failure_after_up: both verdict closes are below their own opening-auction midpoints; propose down
branch_clock.initiative_failure_after_down: both verdict closes are above their own opening-auction midpoints; propose up
branch_clock.entry: next matched-contract MCL one-minute open after the verdict

selection_law: Select the first profile in frozen order that passes every count gate in both periods. Only that profile may receive a later lifecycle preregistration.
prohibitions: no midpoint or auction-close threshold sweep
no stop or timeout rescue in the census
